# Changelog {#sec-changelog .unnumbered}

## v1.3.0

* **`att()`'s default estimator has changed.** The default is now a cross-fitted, Neyman-orthogonal augmented balancing weights estimator (`method = "abw"`); the previous default is unchanged and available via `att(out, method = "lm_robust")`.
* The `"abw"` outcome model is a ridge regression on the standardized columns of `mat`; its penalty is chosen once from the control sample by generalized cross-validation on a fixed grid with a cap on effective degrees of freedom (deterministic, no random numbers).
* `att()` gains `seed` and `nfolds` arguments for `method = "abw"` (ignored by the other methods); `method = "abw"` does not accept `...` arguments such as `se_type` or `clusters`, which still work with `"lm_robust"` and `"lm_lin"`.
* `att()` now errors on an unrecognized `method` value instead of failing with an opaque internal error.
* `att()` with `method = "abw"` now warns when `hbalobject$converged` is 0 (the entropy-balancing weights did not converge), since the estimate and standard error may then be unreliable.
* The package tutorial is now a Quarto book at `tutorial/` (previously `vignettes/tutorial.Rmd`); render it locally with `quarto render` from that directory.
* `plot()` for `hbal` objects no longer calls the deprecated `ggplot2::aes_string()`; the plots are unchanged and the deprecation warning is gone.

## v1.2.16

* Fix `att()` to work with estimatr >= 2.0.0, whose `tidy()` now returns a tibble, without warnings, while remaining identical under estimatr < 2.0.0.

## v1.2.13

* In `att()`, add the method "elnet" by Athey (2018)
* Fix a bug with incorrect variable names

## v1.2.12

* In `att()`, only display the treatment effect by default
* Fix a bug with truncated variable names
* Show a warning when the algorithm is not converged

## v1.2.11

* Allow approximate balance on the level terms (penalty tuned via cross-validation)
* Fix a bug with truncated variable names

## v1.2.9

* Fix a bug which occurs when there is only one covariate

## v1.2.8

* First CRAN release

## v1.2.2

* beta version
